data.name: AdjustmentAmountRequired
data.value: You must supply a non-zero inventory adjustment (count/amount).

data.name: ForItemsNoExpiry
data.value: For items that don't expire enter 0

data.name: HolderHelp
data.value: Select one person or one unit to receive the inventory.

data.name: InitializeDescription
data.value: Initialize the inventory workspace by importing existing inventory, balances, and history.

data.name: MoreChoices
data.value: Only the first page of available choices is shown.

data.name: MovementHelp
data.value: Enter a positive quantity to move. Receipts require a destination; consumption and write-offs require a source. Adjustments require either a source or a destination. Transfers require two different locations.

data.name: ProtectedDataRequired
data.value: Verify your identity to view protected inventory.

data.name: UnableToComplete
data.value: Unable to complete this inventory action.

data.name: WitnessPending
data.value: Awaiting an independent authorized witness. Request ID:

data.name: RecordUsageHelp
data.value: Saving usage changes inventory immediately. These stock changes remain if a draft or amendment is abandoned. Reverse incorrect usage explicitly, then record the replacement. Open an amendment before changing usage on a completed report.

data.name: RecordUsageWitnessHelp
data.value: Controlled-item consumption and reversals require an independent witness in Inventory. Complete that process first, then attach the resulting transaction ID here.

data.name: RecordUsageReverseHelp
data.value: This records a full reversal and keeps the original usage in the history. To correct an amount or item, reverse it and record the replacement. If the reversal was already witnessed in Inventory, enter its transaction ID to attach it without changing stock again.

data.name: RecordUsageLedgerHelp
data.value: Positive quantities record usage; negative quantities reverse it. Open the ledger entry for the movement details under your current inventory access.

data.name: RecordUsageAttachHelp
data.value: Enter a completed Inventory consumption transaction to attach its item, quantity, location and note. The new-consumption fields below are ignored, and stock is not consumed again. Select the usage type above.

data.name: RecordUsageLocationHelp
data.value: Leave blank to use the report's responding unit, with the station as fallback. Choose a source explicitly when the report has multiple possible locations.

data.name: RecordUsageSaved
data.value: Usage saved and supporting evidence captured.

data.name: RecordUsageEvidencePending
data.value: The inventory action was saved. Evidence could not be captured; use Refresh evidence after resolving access or draft changes. Do not submit the inventory action again.

data.name: RecordUsageDraftChanged
data.value: The draft changed. Check the recorded usage before submitting another inventory action.

data.name: RecordUsageWitnessRequired
data.value: Complete the independent witness process in Inventory, then attach the resulting transaction ID here. No stock movement was recorded by this action.

data.name: RecordUsageReconciliationRequired
data.value: A ledger reversal has not been linked to this report. Attach it as a correction before finalizing.

data.name: M4VendorHelp
data.value: Suppliers use company records from Contacts. Create or update company details in Contacts, then link the company here.

data.name: M4OrderHelp
data.value: Marking an order as ordered locks its lines. Cancelling an order prevents further receipts and keeps quantities already received.

data.name: M4ReceiptHelp
data.value: Receive all or part of an order. Remove lines not included in this delivery. If an independent witness is required, stock and received quantities change only after approval in Inventory.

data.name: M4SerializedReceiptHelp
data.value: Use one row for each serialized asset, with quantity 1 and its own serial number. Add rows to receive more assets or split quantities across locations or lots.

data.name: M4ValuationScope
data.value: Valuation covers only the inventory and locations you are authorized to view. Totals are separate for each currency. Rows with an unknown cost are counted separately and excluded from known value totals.

data.name: M4NegativeStock
data.value: Some visible stock balances are negative. Review them before relying on this valuation.

data.name: M4CurrencyHelp
data.value: Use one currency per item. Existing inventory without a currency stays separate in valuation; assigning a currency does not convert costs.

data.name: M5CountHelp
data.value: Start a snapshot of up to 100 positions. Record every quantity, save, then complete. If stock or catalog data changes, cancel and start a fresh count. Record newly discovered serialized equipment through Receive.

data.name: M5WitnessHelp
data.value: An independent witness must approve the pending operation from Inventory history. The snapshot must still be current.

data.name: M5AlertHelp
data.value: Alerts show low stock, expiration within 30 days, expired inventory and overdue returns. Refresh once after rollout to initialize low-stock alerts, and after importing legacy inventory. Later stock and item edits update them automatically.

data.name: M5ReportHelp
data.value: Select a report and optional filters. Dates use UTC with an exclusive end date. Snapshot reports use current holdings. Download the PDF to view or print it.

data.name: M5AlertNotificationMessage
data.value: Inventory needs attention. Sign in to review current alerts.

data.name: M5ScheduledReportProtected
data.value: Inventory contains protected data. Open the authenticated report link and verify your identity to view or print current results. This scheduled PDF contains no inventory values.

data.name: M5ReportScope
data.value: This report includes only inventory and locations you are currently authorized to view. Quantities and values describe the stated snapshot; results are limited to 5,000 rows.

data.name: M5ReportMethodUsage
data.value: Each stock movement appears once. Positive quantities record outward usage; negative quantities reverse it. Record details require access to the source. Imported outward movements retain their legacy identity and do not establish a link to a Log or patient.

data.name: M5ReportMethodLowStock
data.value: Active items are listed when visible bulk stock or serialized holdings are at or below the reorder point, falling back to minimum stock. Serialized holdings include in-service, issued, damaged and repair assets. Hidden locations are excluded.

data.name: M5ReportMethodIssuance
data.value: Rows show issuances created within the selected date range and their current return status. Outstanding quantities on older issuances require an earlier start date.

data.name: M5ReportMethodExpiration
data.value: Rows show current positive stock and active serialized holdings with an expiration date in the selected range. The default includes already expired inventory and inventory expiring in the next 30 days.

data.name: M5ReferenceType0
data.value: Inventory movement without an accessible Record link

data.name: InvalidCount
data.value: Enter valid count details and quantities.

data.name: CountScopeTooLarge
data.value: Select a smaller scope. Counts support up to 100 positions.

data.name: CountEmpty
data.value: There are no active inventory positions to count in this scope.

data.name: CountAlreadyExists
data.value: This count already exists. Open it from the counts list.

data.name: CountStateConflict
data.value: The count changed or has incomplete observations. Reload it and save all quantities before completion.

data.name: CountSnapshotChanged
data.value: Inventory changed after this snapshot. Cancel this count and start a fresh one.

data.name: CountReceiptImmutable
data.value: Count adjustments belong to their completed count. Start a new count to correct stock.

data.name: CountCompletionRequired
data.value: Post count variances by completing the stock count.

data.name: InvalidReportRange
data.value: Select a valid UTC date range of no more than 366 days.

data.name: ReportChanged
data.value: The report changed while generating the PDF. Generate it again.

data.name: ReportGenerationFailed
data.value: The report could not be generated. Try again.

data.name: HolderHistoryRetained
data.value: This resource is referenced by inventory history and must be retained.

data.name: WorkOrderPostingRequired
data.value: Post or reverse this part through its work order.

data.name: AssetSafetyHold
data.value: A maintenance safety hold prevents returning this equipment to service.

data.name: ReadinessProRequired
data.value: Readiness Pro is required for new maintenance work.

data.name: NoRowsHelp
data.value: Nothing here yet. Use the buttons above to create the first record.

data.name: RequiredFieldsMissing
data.value: Fill in the highlighted fields before continuing.

data.name: ReviewHint
data.value: Check the answers below, then save.

data.name: WorkspaceIntro
data.value: Track what your department owns, where it is kept and who is carrying it.

data.name: M4PurchasingIntro
data.value: Manage suppliers, raise purchase orders and see what your stock is worth.

data.name: M5OperationsIntro
data.value: Run physical counts, work through alerts and print inventory reports.

data.name: HelpOnHand
data.value: What you hold right now, by item and location. Filter to one item or place, then adjust the stock when a count changes.

data.name: HelpItems
data.value: Items are the things you stock: the catalogue entry, not a physical object. Decide how each one is tracked before you add stock for it.

data.name: HelpCategories
data.value: Categories group items so lists and reports stay readable. A category can sit under a parent category.

data.name: HelpLocations
data.value: Locations are where stock lives: stations, apparatus, people, containers, or a shelf inside another location.

data.name: HelpLots
data.value: A lot is a batch of one item sharing a lot number, an expiry date and a cost.

data.name: HelpAssets
data.value: Assets are individually serialised pieces of equipment. Each one has its own serial number, status and history.

data.name: HelpIssuances
data.value: Equipment currently signed out to a person or an apparatus. Record a return when it comes back.

data.name: HelpKits
data.value: A kit is a fixed list of items issued together, such as a turnout gear set or a medic bag.

data.name: HelpTransfers
data.value: Move stock between two locations. Both sides of the move are written to the ledger.

data.name: HelpHistory
data.value: Every movement is written to an append-only ledger. Filter it by item or location to audit a change.

data.name: HelpAssetDetail
data.value: The full history of a single asset, together with its checklists and work orders.

data.name: HelpTransaction
data.value: A single ledger entry, shown exactly as it was written.

data.name: HelpUnitEquipment
data.value: Everything currently assigned to the selected apparatus.

data.name: HelpPersonnelGear
data.value: Everything currently signed out to the selected person.

data.name: HelpHolderLookup
data.value: Look up everything held by one apparatus or one person.

data.name: HelpLocationRename
data.value: Only the name can change here. Placement and scope were fixed when the location was created.

data.name: HelpAssetStatus
data.value: Changing the status writes a ledger entry. Use it when equipment goes for repair, is damaged, lost or retired.

data.name: HelpWitness
data.value: Enter the request number shown when the movement was posted, then attest to what you saw.

data.name: M4HelpVendors
data.value: Suppliers you buy from. Each one is linked to a company contact and can carry an account number.

data.name: M4HelpPurchaseOrders
data.value: Raise an order with a supplier, then receive against it. Receiving posts the stock and records what it cost.

data.name: M4HelpValuation
data.value: What the stock you hold is worth, using the cost recorded when it was received.

data.name: M5NoAlertsHelp
data.value: No alerts are open. Refresh to check stock levels, expiry dates and overdue returns again.

data.name: M5CountEnterHelp
data.value: Enter what you actually counted for every line. The variance column updates once the count is saved.

data.name: M5CountNameHelp
data.value: Something you will recognise later, such as "Station 2 annual count".

data.name: HelpFieldAmount
data.value: How many units, in the item's unit of measure.

data.name: HelpFieldAsset
data.value: For serialised items, pick the exact unit being moved.

data.name: HelpFieldCategory
data.value: Optional grouping used by lists and reports.

data.name: HelpFieldCode
data.value: Your own stock or part number, if you use one.

data.name: HelpFieldCurrency
data.value: Three letter currency code, such as USD or EUR.

data.name: HelpFieldDefaultLocation
data.value: New stock lands here when no location is chosen.

data.name: HelpFieldExpectedReturn
data.value: Overdue returns are flagged on the alerts screen.

data.name: HelpFieldExpiration
data.value: The date this stock stops being usable.

data.name: HelpFieldFromLocation
data.value: Where the stock is leaving. Leave blank when bringing new stock in.

data.name: HelpFieldHolder
data.value: Choose a person or an apparatus, not both.

data.name: HelpFieldIsActive
data.value: Inactive items stay in history but cannot be chosen for new movements.

data.name: HelpFieldIsControlledSubstance
data.value: Movements need a second person to witness them and are kept for audit.

data.name: HelpFieldIsKit
data.value: Mark this as a kit container rather than something you stock on its own.

data.name: HelpFieldLocationType
data.value: Station, apparatus, person, container, or a sub-location of another place.

data.name: HelpFieldLot
data.value: Pick the batch this stock came from, if the item is lot tracked.

data.name: HelpFieldMinimum
data.value: Raise an alert when the amount on hand falls below this.

data.name: HelpFieldNote
data.value: Why this happened. Notes appear on the ledger and on reports.

data.name: HelpFieldParent
data.value: Optional. Nest this under another record.

data.name: HelpFieldReorderPoint
data.value: Suggest reordering once the amount on hand reaches this.

data.name: HelpFieldReportRange
data.value: Snapshot reports ignore the date range.

data.name: HelpFieldRequiresExpiration
data.value: Require an expiry date so this item appears on expiry alerts.

data.name: HelpFieldRequiresLotTracking
data.value: Require a lot number whenever stock of this item is received.

data.name: HelpFieldReturnCondition
data.value: The state the equipment came back in.

data.name: HelpFieldSerialNumber
data.value: Manufacturer serial. It must be unique for this item.

data.name: HelpFieldToLocation
data.value: Where the stock is going. Leave blank when consuming or writing stock off.

data.name: HelpFieldTrackingMode
data.value: Bulk counts a quantity. Serialised tracks every unit separately, with its own serial number and history.

data.name: HelpFieldUnitCost
data.value: Cost of one unit, used for valuation.

data.name: HelpFieldUnitOfMeasure
data.value: How you count it: each, box, litre, metre.

data.name: M4AccountNumberHelp
data.value: The account this supplier knows you by.

data.name: M4CompanyContactHelp
data.value: Pick the company contact this supplier record belongs to.

data.name: M4NewVendorHint
data.value: A supplier is a company contact you buy from. Add the contact first if it is not in the list.

data.name: M4PurchaseOrderNumberHelp
data.value: Your reference for this order. It appears on the ledger when the stock is received.

data.name: M4StepOrderHeaderHint
data.value: Who you are buying from, under what reference, and in which currency.

data.name: M4StepOrderLinesHint
data.value: One line per item. Quantities and costs here are what you will receive against.

data.name: M5StepCountBasicsHint
data.value: A count freezes a snapshot of your stock so you can compare it with what is on the shelf.

data.name: M5StepCountScopeHint
data.value: Count one location, or leave it blank to count the whole department.

data.name: M5StepReportKindHint
data.value: The report decides which of the filters on the next step apply.

data.name: M5StepReportFiltersHint
data.value: Leave a filter blank to include everything. Unavailable filters are greyed out.

data.name: StepAssetItemHint
data.value: An asset is one physical unit of an item. Say which item it is and where it will live.

data.name: StepAssetIdentityHint
data.value: How this unit is identified when someone picks it up or scans it.

data.name: StepIssueWhatHint
data.value: Choose the item and the place it is coming out of.

data.name: StepIssueWhenHint
data.value: When you expect it back, and anything worth recording about the hand-over.

data.name: StepItemBasicsHint
data.value: What people will see when they search for this in a list.

data.name: StepItemTrackingHint
data.value: These answers decide what the system asks for later, so they are hard to change once stock exists.

data.name: StepItemStockHint
data.value: Optional thresholds that drive low stock alerts, plus the cost used for valuation.

data.name: StepKitBasicsHint
data.value: Kits are issued as a whole, so give this one a name your crews will recognise.

data.name: StepKitContentsHint
data.value: List every item the kit contains and how many of each.

data.name: StepKitIssueHint
data.value: Confirm which physical unit and which shelf each part of the kit is coming from.

data.name: StepLocationBasicsHint
data.value: The name shows up in every drop-down that asks where something is.

data.name: StepLocationScopeHint
data.value: Fill in only the field that matches the type you chose; leave the rest blank.

data.name: StepLotDetailsHint
data.value: The lot number as printed on the packaging, plus what the batch cost and when it expires.

data.name: StepLotItemHint
data.value: Lots always belong to one item, so pick it first.

data.name: StepMovementWhatHint
data.value: The kind of movement decides which of the fields below the system will use.

data.name: StepMovementWhereHint
data.value: Receiving needs only a destination; consuming or writing off needs only a source.

data.name: StepMovementAmountHint
data.value: The quantity and the reason. Both end up on the ledger entry this creates.

data.name: StepReturnHint
data.value: Say how much came back, where it went, and what condition it is in.
